title: Refund policy
text: Customers may request a standard subscription refund within 30 calendar days of the original charge. Gift cards, consumed usage credits, and custom onboarding fees are nonrefundable. Requests must include the account ID and charge date.

title: Password reset security
text: Password reset links expire 20 minutes after issue. A link is revoked immediately after it is used, and requesting a new link revokes the previous one. Support agents never ask for a customer's password.

title: Support data retention
text: Attachments on support tickets are deleted 90 days after the ticket closes. Ticket messages are retained for 180 days. Security audit logs are retained for 365 days.

title: Public API rate limits
text: The Starter plan allows 60 API requests per minute. The Pro plan allows 600 API requests per minute. Enterprise limits are defined in the customer contract.

title: Incident severity targets
text: A P1 incident has a 15 minute initial response target and continuous work until mitigation. A P2 incident has a 2 business hour initial response target. Lower severities are handled during regional business hours.

title: Account data exports
text: Account owners can request a JSON data export from the administration console. Export links remain available for 48 hours. Only owners and administrators can create an export.

title: Single sign-on availability
text: SAML single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan. Administrators configure identity provider metadata and must test access with a non-owner account before enforcement.
